_comment: Idea -> prompt -> image, in ONE graph. Qwen3.5-2B writes the prompt, Qwen-Image 2512 + the 4-step Lightning LoRA renders it. You type six words into node 2 and get a fully art-directed 1664x928 render. The whole thing is local. This is the single most useful workflow in the kit for ideation.
_notes: The trick is that node 12's `text` is fed by a LINK instead of a typed string. Any widget input in ComfyUI can be driven by a link in API format, so the LLM's STRING output lands straight in CLIPTextEncode. No copy-paste step.

Two models are resident at once: Qwen3.5-2B (4.5 GB) plus Qwen-Image fp8 (20 GB) plus the 7B VL encoder (9.4 GB). That overcommits 32 GB, so ComfyUI offloads between the text and image stages. The first run pays that cost; back-to-back runs with the same models are much faster.
sampling_mode is a dynamic combo - its sub-inputs must be passed as dotted keys ('sampling_mode.temperature', not 'temperature'). See workflow 15's notes.

Change ONLY node 2's IDEA line for a new concept. Change node 2's sampling_mode.seed for a different prompt from the same idea - that is a much bigger creative lever than changing the image seed, because it rewrites the composition rather than reshuffling noise.
Keep the negative prompt (node 13) typed by hand. Letting the LLM write negatives makes it list things it then describes, which drags them into the image.
steps=4 / cfg=1.0 is mandatory with the Lightning LoRA. If you remove the LoRA (node 4) go to steps=20 / cfg=3.5 and expect ~30 s instead of ~5 s.
shift=3.1 on ModelSamplingAuraFlow is tuned for 1664x928. Raise toward 4-5 for square, lower toward 2.5 for very wide panoramas.

inputs.prompt:
You are a prompt engineer for the Qwen-Image diffusion model. Rewrite the idea below as ONE dense English paragraph, 60-90 words, no line breaks, no preamble, no bullet points, no commentary. Name the subject first, then pose and expression, then setting, then lighting with direction and quality, then lens and camera angle, then the colour palette, then the medium and finish. Be concrete and physical. Never use the words beautiful, stunning, masterpiece, detailed, 4k, or 8k.

IDEA: a deep-sea welder repairing a drowned cathedral bell

inputs.text: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, jpeg artifacts, oversaturated, extra limbs, deformed hands
